title: 1986 LEAF ALL STAR GAME GARY CARTER NEW YORK METS FOLD OUT POP UP FIGURE
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1986 Leaf baseball sports trading card featuring Gary Carter of the New York Mets. The card is a fold-out pop-up figure from the All-Star Game set. It is card number #75 and is not a modified item.
